howBytesWereMeasured.digests: sha256sum, and `git show <commit>:<path> | sha256sum` for historical blobs.
howBytesWereMeasured.pdfStructure: A reader written for this lane loading each delivered fixture with pdf-lib 1.17.1 from this worktree's node_modules, walking the page tree, counting /Widget annotations per page, reading the AcroForm /Fields array size, and inflating every page /Contents stream with node:zlib. howBytesWereMeasured.textAndPosition: pdftotext -bbox on the pinned source and on each delivered fixture. A word counts as ADDED only when the triple (text, xMin rounded to 0.1pt, yMin rounded to 0.1pt) is absent from the mapped source page, and LOST only when present in the source and absent from the delivered page. Top-left coordinates were converted to PDF space as pageHeight - yMax.
howBytesWereMeasured.pixels: pdftoppm -r 300 -gray writing binary P5 PGM directly (never -gray -png, which emits an RGB PNG a naive grayscale reader misreads silently), read by a numpy PGM reader written for this lane. Annotations ARE drawn: poppler's default, no suppression flag. Ink threshold: grey value < 200 is ink. Scope: every page of every delivered fixture, differenced against the mapped page of its pinned source at identical raster dimensions. Every raster was read and deleted in the same working directory before this lane returned; none was retained, published or looked at by a person.
howBytesWereMeasured.insideOrOutsideADeclaredRect: Declared write rects were converted from PDF points to raster pixels at 300 dpi with a 1 px pad, and separately with a 3 pt allowance below the rect for glyph descenders. Both figures are published below, because the difference between them is the whole of the residue.
howBytesWereMeasured.verbatimDisclosure: A record string counts as disclosed only when, after whitespace collapse, it appears as an exact substring of the delivered markdown. Absence was additionally checked by grepping for the distinguishing token of the string.

obligationFindings.REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING: FAIL. Both controlling records carry a requiredBeforeFiling list of five entries for this packet set -- legal-design-track-registry.json track ia-12347 at packetSet.requiredBeforeFiling and packetSet.participantActionRequired, and the same five, byte-identical, in the packetSets entry of data/record-clearing/legal-design-packet-set-manifests.json. The second entry is: 'Confirmation that the conviction is under § 123.47(3) — Form 4, item 1.' kind complete_field, requirement required, requiredBeforeFiling true. It reaches the participant nowhere. The strings '123.47(3)' and 'subsection' each occur ZERO times in participant-instructions.md and ZERO times in filing-instructions.md; the only occurrences of '123.47' at all are three, and all three are the general or the (9) citation. The other four entries are disclosed in substance: the A/B election and the signature under penalty of perjury both appear, the fee position appears, and the fee-waiver position is stated as not applicable. This is not a wording quibble. The record explains in its own words why the confirmation exists: manualCompletionItems records item 'Confirmation that the conviction is under § 123.47(3)', whereInPacket 'Form 4, item 1', why 'The form cites § 123.47 generally where the statutory ground is subsection 3, so the participant confirms the subsection.' The printed item 1 is broader than the eligible ground, so a participant convicted under a different part of § 123.47 reads a statement that is true of them, is told to check it against their court record, and is never told that the part that matters is subsection 3. WHAT WOULD SATISFY IT: the guide states, in the participant's own reading, that the form's item 1 cites § 123.47 generally, that this route is available only for a conviction under § 123.47(3), and that the participant must confirm their conviction is under subsection 3 before signing -- which is the record's own participantQuestions sentence.
obligationFindings.ROUTE_OPTIONS: FAIL, and it is the same defect class VF55 measured on al-trafficking-set. Page 1 of Rule 2.86 Form 4 prints 'Read, complete, and check each item if you agree.' above two numbered sworn statements, under a preamble reading 'Defendant acknowledges that the following statements are true and correct to the best of Defendant's knowledge'. The packet checks BOTH. The field map records them as eligible_conviction_selected (item 1, factId route.ia_123_47_conviction, disposition selected_by_route, routeDetermined true) and no_later_disqualifying_conviction_selected (item 2, factId route.no_later_disqualifying_conviction, same). This lane measured both marks in the delivered pixels rather than in the report: at 300 dpi, grey<200, each mark adds 241 px over the pinned source at its declared rect, identically in canonical and boundary. On ITEM 2 this lane does not fail the family: the record collects interveningConvictions as a required generation requirement and item 2 restates that fact exactly, so the platform plausibly holds what it asserts. ITEM 1 IS DIFFERENT AND THE RECORD DRAWS THE LINE ITSELF. Item 1 is the ONE field in this packet that both controlling records name as a participant manual completion required before filing -- manualCompletionItems whereInPacket 'Form 4, item 1', participantActionRequired kind complete_field requiredBeforeFiling true, and packetSet.requiredBeforeFiling entry two -- for the stated reason that the printed statement is broader than the eligible ground. Marking routeDetermined true on the one election the record reserves to the participant is a claim the route determines it, and the record it would have to cite says the opposite. That the guide discloses the mark ('Two statements on page 1 are already marked for you') does not cure it: accurate disclosure of an unauthorised election is not authority to make it, and the disclosure repeats the form's general § 123.47 wording rather than the subsection the confirmation is about. WHAT WOULD SATISFY IT: either reclassify eligible_conviction_selected to routeDetermined false, stop marking it, and carry the record's participant confirmation into the guide; or an owner determination, recorded as one, that a manualCompletionItem may be pre-answered by the build -- which would have to be applied to every route whose record reserves an election to the participant. This lane's view is that the first is right.

obligationFindings.FILING_DESTINATION: PASS. The registry's destination is kind clerk, 'Clerk of the Iowa District Court for the county of the case', detail 'File in the case where expungement is sought.'; venue is 'Iowa District Court for the county of the case. Rule 2.82(5) requires filing in the case where expungement is sought.'; rules.filing is 'eFile through the Iowa Judicial Branch eFile System where the case is available there, otherwise file on paper at the county clerk of court office...' filing-instructions.md carries all three: 'File the application in the Iowa District Court for the county shown in the caption on page 1 - the county where the criminal case was handled - under the case number shown beside it', then step 5 eFile and step 6 'file on paper at the clerk of court's office for that county'. obligationFindings.FEE_AND_WAIVER: FAIL, on an omission the record explicitly instructs be surfaced. What IS carried is carried honestly: rules.fees ('No filing fee for the application itself was identified in the review') and rules.feeWaiver ('Not applicable while no fee is identified') are reflected by filing-instructions.md 'The held source establishes no filing fee for this application... Nothing in this packet states an amount', which attributes the finding to the held source rather than asserting there is no fee. What is MISSING is the third and only actionable part of this track's fee answer. The registry carries, as packetInstructions and again as a legalDesignLimitations entry classified packet_instruction with counsel-memo provenance: 'Court debt is not a precondition on this track. Rule 2.83(3) states that payment of court debt or other financial obligations is not required for expungement under this section. Surface it: this is the opposite of Tracks A and B and matters most to participants least able to pay.' The phrases 'court debt', '2.83' and 'financial obligation' occur ZERO times in participant-instructions.md and ZERO times in filing-instructions.md. A participant with outstanding court debt reads this packet, is told nothing, and has every reason to believe the barrier that applies on most tracks applies here -- which is the one class of participant the record says this matters most to. Secondarily, rules.fees says 'Treat the amount as unconfirmed until verified at build time', the family's releaseBlockers still carry the open question 'Whether there is any filing fee for a Rule 2.86 application in any Iowa county', and the guide does not tell the participant the amount is unconfirmed. WHAT WOULD SATISFY IT: the guide states Rule 2.83(3) in the participant's own reading -- that unpaid court debt or other financial obligations do not have to be paid first on this route -- and states that no fee has been confirmed either way. MAPPING NOTE FOR THE CAPTAIN: this lane scores the court-debt omission under FEE_AND_WAIVER because it is a statement about whether money is a precondition to the relief. If the Captain maps a packet_instruction omission elsewhere, the measurement is unchanged and the family is FAIL_REPAIR_REQUIRED regardless, on ROUTE_OPTIONS and REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.
obligationFindings.SERVICE: PASS. rules.service is 'eFiling serves the county attorney automatically. Paper filers complete the certification of service and mail or hand deliver a copy to the county attorney.' and rules.notice is 'The county attorney is the notice recipient and may file a confidential response within 20 days after service unless the court orders otherwise. The court may conduct a hearing but none is required.' Both halves of the service rule are carried in filing-instructions.md steps 5 and 6 in the record's own terms, and the notice rule is carried verbatim in BOTH delivered documents. The recipient's identity and address are correctly left to the participant with an explanation of each of the five fields, and the certificate is left wholly blank with the reason stated -- 'a certificate that says a copy was mailed on a date when it had not been mailed would be false'. This lane confirmed in the pixels that every field of the certification of service is unwritten in both fixtures.
obligationFindings.SELF_HELP_STOP: PASS, and this is the obligation VF03 failed. Track ia-12347 declares exactly two selfHelpStopConditions and both are present verbatim in participant-instructions.md under a '## Stop and get help' heading: 'The county attorney opposes the application.' and 'A disputed intervening conviction inside the two-year window.' 2 of 2, matched as exact substrings after whitespace collapse against the registry read at this base. Each is then carried in terms as well as verbatim -- 'If the county attorney opposes the application, this packet stops being enough', with the 20-day confidential-response window and the court's discretion to hold a hearing -- and filing-instructions.md carries the same stop under 'After filing': 'A response is where this packet's help ends.' That is precisely the sentence VF03 said reached nobody. The repair is builder-durable, not a hand edit: it is in scripts/build-census-v1-ia-12347-set.mjs, and build-findings.json records the sentences are asserted verbatim against both records at build time.
